---
description: "Rules for Discourse theme SCSS, design tokens, responsive behavior, generated Paloma CSS, and scoped core overrides."
applyTo: "stylesheets/**,common/**"
---

# Theme styles

## File ownership

- `stylesheets/brand/`: EA tokens and brand primitives.
- `stylesheets/app/`: narrowly scoped changes to native Discourse application surfaces.
- `stylesheets/components/`: EA custom components and React-island composition.
- `stylesheets/blocks/`: homepage block layouts.
- `stylesheets/components/ea-paloma-generated.scss`: generated by Vite; never edit manually.

Register every authored stylesheet in the matching `_index.scss`. `common/common.scss` imports the
three stylesheet groups.

## Scope before overriding

Inspect the actual core selector and computed styles before writing an override. Scope changes to
an EA class or route-level class so they do not unexpectedly affect Admin, the composer, modals,
chat, or plugin UI.

Avoid `!important`. Raise specificity narrowly only when a proven core rule requires it. Add a
short comment naming the behavior being overridden.

Do not hide core controls until the EA replacement is mounted, keyboard accessible, permission
aware, and proven on all routes where the core control appears.

## Tokens and color modes

Use EA variables from `stylesheets/brand/`, Discourse variables for native UI, and Paloma tokens
inside Paloma components. Avoid copying literal Figma colors throughout component files.

React islands currently render under Paloma dark mode, but native Discourse and Admin routes can
still use their own color scheme. Scope unconditional dark surfaces to EA components instead of
making global assumptions.

## Responsive behavior

Prefer the installed Discourse viewport mixins when editing native app layout:

```scss
@use "lib/viewport";

@include viewport.until(lg) { /* ... */ }
```

Use design-specific container queries or media queries only when the component requirement cannot
be expressed with the Discourse breakpoints. Test the widths represented in Figma and boundary
widths immediately above and below each breakpoint.

The custom side rail is desktop-only in the current design. Below its breakpoint, verify that the
native Discourse drawer and navigation remain usable.

## Async island layout

Reserve enough space for delayed islands to avoid layout shift, especially in the header and above
the fold. Do not reserve a fixed height that clips translated text or wrapped mobile content.

Keep this structural rule unless the provider markup changes:

```scss
.ea-react-island > [data-paloma-mode] {
  display: contents;
}
```

Outlet wrappers mean sibling selectors inside different islands may never meet. Inspect the real
DOM before choosing selectors for spacing between sections.

## Verification

For each changed viewport, verify:

- no horizontal overflow;
- header, sidebar/drawer, composer, modal, and Admin usability when globally affected;
- text wrapping at 200% zoom;
- keyboard focus is visible;
- loading does not create an excessive layout shift;
- computed spacing, sizes, type, radii, and colors match the accepted design values.

Do not use a screenshot as the only evidence. Record computed or bounding-box measurements for
exact design-parity work.
